marble.prompt: A photorealistic 360-degree view from eye level on top of a gentle grassy hill in soft morning light. Rolling green meadows slope away in every direction under a clear pale sky with a few thin clouds. A flock of white sheep grazes in the middle distance on one side of the hill. On another side stands a small stone shepherd's hut with a chimney. On a third side a lone old oak tree stands on the slope. On the fourth side the hill falls toward a calm lake with snowy mountains far beyond.

projection.notes: yaw_deg rotates which pano direction becomes the front wall. Pick it from seams.jpg so wall boundaries do not cut sheep.

orbis.notes: Written from faces/<face>.png after projection (yaw 12). Describe only what each image shows; motion is only for things already in the image. Prompt = camera + scene + motion + look. tools/scene_prompts.py compiles and word-counts them.

camera.wall: Eye-level wide shot, static locked-off camera, deep depth of field.
camera.floor: Overhead shot looking straight down at the ground, static locked-off camera.
camera.ceiling: Low-angle shot looking straight up at the sky, static locked-off camera.

orbis.look: Soft hazy morning light, muted desaturated greens under a pale grey-beige sky.

front.scene: A grassy hill crest rises gently from left to right. Just right of centre, five white sheep stand together on the crest. Hazy distant mountains lie on the left. A pale sun glows high in the upper left of the sky. The corner of a small dark wooden hut sits at the far right edge.
front.motion: The sheep graze in place with their heads down; one occasionally lifts its head. The grass ripples softly in the breeze.

right.scene: A large lone oak tree stands on the hill crest in the left third of the frame, casting a long dark shadow down the slope to the right. A small dark wooden hut with a pointed roof sits at the far left edge. On the right the slope falls away into a hazy valley.
right.motion: The oak's leaves stir gently in the breeze. Thin haze drifts slowly across the valley.

back.scene: The hillside falls away to a wide calm blue lake ringed by low green hills and short cliffs along the far shore. A pale weathered log and a few brown boulders lie in the grass on the near shore at the lower right.
back.motion: Small ripples shimmer across the lake surface and catch the light. The grass in the foreground sways gently.

left.scene: A range of green mountains with snow-capped peaks stretches across the frame beyond a still lake inlet. A darker forested ridge rises on the left. A grassy slope fills the foreground and climbs toward the right. Above the peaks is an open hazy sky.
left.motion: Low wisps of cloud drift slowly over the snowy peaks. The lake surface shimmers faintly.

floor.scene: Short dense olive-green meadow grass covers the whole frame, with a few lighter patches and tiny wildflowers.
floor.motion: The grass blades sway gently in place in a light breeze.

ceiling.scene: An even pale grey-beige hazy sky fills the frame, brighter where the sun glows near the top edge. A few leafy oak branches reach in at the upper left corner.
ceiling.motion: Thin veils of haze drift very slowly across the sky.

front.env_first: Static tripod shot at eye level; the frame never moves. Wide landscape view with deep depth of field. A broad grassy hill crest rises gently from left to right under a pale hazy sky, a pale sun high in the upper left and hazy mountains far off on the left. Far away on the crest, a few tiny white sheep graze slowly in the distance. The corner of a small dark hut stands at the far right edge. The grass ripples softly in the breeze. Soft hazy morning light, muted desaturated greens.
front.cinemagraph: A cinemagraph: a still photograph of a grassy hill crest under a pale hazy sky, taken at eye level from a fixed tripod; the frame never moves. The hill rises gently from left to right, a pale sun hangs upper left and hazy mountains lie far off left. A few tiny white sheep stand still far away on the crest, and the corner of a small dark hut stands at the far right edge. Only the grass sways softly in the wind and thin haze drifts slowly across the sky. Soft hazy morning light, muted greens.

orbis.variants_notes: Experimental opening prompts, selected with tools/orbis_wall_test.py --variant <name>. env_first: environment before subject, sheep 'tiny, far away', stronger camera lock. cinemagraph: frames the shot as a still photo with local motion, fixed tripod, sheep tiny and still, only wind and haze move.
